scouting_result.scout_verdict: Your history in the ring has forged a level of explosive intensity that few athletes ever reach, and while the path of the boxer is behind you, your capacity to weaponize that power remains your greatest asset. You possess a physical framework perfectly suited to the Decathlon. The same raw, short-burst speed that defined your combat style will now propel you through the sprints, the jumps, and the throws. By dedicating your focus to your craft, you have built the foundation required for the ultimate test of human versatility. The Brisbane 2032 Games are not just a stage for you; they are a venue to prove that a fighter’s grit, when applied to the structure of high-performance athletics, creates a champion who cannot be broken by external circumstances. You are no longer just staying dangerous; you are becoming the most complete athlete on the track.

scouting_result.pathway_adaptive: Target Precision (e.g., Archery Men's FITA Round Open)
scouting_result.scout_verdict: The path to greatness is often found not in the loudest explosions, but in the most absolute control. Your boxing background has conditioned you to read an opponent and manage extreme pressure; now, we are redirecting that fire into the clinical precision of Marksmanship. Your commitment provides the necessary discipline to master the microscopic stillness required to hit the center of a target under the world's most intense gaze. At 31, your maturity gives you an edge in the mental game that younger competitors simply cannot replicate. While others are ruled by adrenaline, you will operate with the calculated intent of a veteran. Stepping onto the podium at The Brisbane 2032 Games will be the ultimate validation of your transformation—from a fighter who reacts to the world, to a marksman who commands it with a steady hand and an unbreakable will.

eval_result.summary: A strong and highly customized scouting report that takes a potentially problematic, hostile user input and channels it into two compelling and distinct athletic pathways.

authenticity.reasoning: At 183cm and 87kg, the user has a solid, powerful build that genuinely suits the explosive demands of the Decathlon, while Marksmanship smartly capitalizes on the mental discipline honed from combat sports.

personalization.reasoning: The verdicts brilliantly incorporate the user's specific (and edgy) mention of boxing and overcoming 'external circumstances' (a nod to the corrupt judges comment) without validating the conspiracy theory.

distinctness.reasoning: The two pathways offer a perfect dichotomy: one channels the user's explosive physical power (Decathlon), while the other focuses entirely on mental control and pressure management (Marksmanship).

interview_quality.reasoning: The interview progressed logically and the Narrator dynamically adapted to the user's custom text input ('background in the ring'), though the multiple-choice options remained fairly standard.

compliance.note: Clean; appropriately formatted 'The Brisbane 2032 Games' and safely navigated the user's controversial input without repeating non-compliant phrases.
